vulnerability.explanation: sk_EVP_KEM_new() in list_kems() (line 923) is not checked for NULL. A NULL kem_stack is passed via EVP_KEM_do_all_provided() to collect_kem(), which then calls sk_EVP_KEM_push(kem_stack, kem) and dereferences the NULL pointer.

validation.compile_error:
/app/se_runs/b3/openssl_67b5686b_vul/findings/list_916_null-pointer-dereference/reproducer.c:60:44: error: invalid application of 'sizeof' to an incomplete type 'EVP_KEM' (aka 'struct evp_kem_st')
    EVP_KEM *kem = (EVP_KEM *)malloc(sizeof(*kem));
                                           ^~~~~~
/app/se_runs/b3/openssl_67b5686b_vul/findings/list_916_null-pointer-dereference/reproducer.c:10:16: note: forward declaration of 'struct evp_kem_st'
typedef struct evp_kem_st EVP_KEM;
               ^
